summary: A 20-foot container spreader: a welded lifting frame on a four-sheave headblock, with four twistlocks on the… joints twist_fl, twist_fr, twist_rl, twist_rr, flip_fl, flip_fr, …; options locks, paint; sockets socket_reeve, socket_load.
